title: Encoded suffix slice
statement: Given natural numbers $a,k$ and an encoded pair of Boolean lists $z$, decode its first and second components as $x$ and $y$. Remove the first $a(|x|+1)^k$ entries of $y$, then encode the pair consisting of $x$ and the remaining suffix.
